race.description: Dailey Family Funerals Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: SUPER VITALITY (10) has the most persuasive form, resuming last start at Tamworth with a fourth, beaten a length, after being prominent in betting. Best figure last prep, a strong third at Scone over a similar distance to this, reads well. Strips fitter today and in a race that lacks depth of quality he gets his chance to break through. UNALIENABLE RIGHT (4) was only battling when sixth at Tamworth last start, but his Tuncurry second first-up was a genuine pointer. Can bounce back at the third run of the campaign. THIRTY DEGREES (3) brings the most consistent recent profile with placings in two of three runs this season, though his record at around 1150m is the main reservation. ECHO OF A WHISPER (7) resumes. Last appeared three months back at Muswellbrook - that fourth had merit after she was held up late. Good enough to be competitive. MUST DIAMOND (8) wasn't all that far away on debut last start at Taree and there is plenty of improvement in the locker.
